title: Payment Failure During Checkout
root_cause: Payment object was null before payment processing.
resolution: Validate the payment object before accessing payment details.

title: Login Application Failure
root_cause: User session object was null during authentication.
resolution: Check whether the user session exists before accessing session attributes.

title: Database Connection Failure
root_cause: Database connection was unavailable when the query was executed.
resolution: Verify database connectivity and handle connection failures before executing queries.

title: Order Processing Failure
root_cause: Order object was null during order processing.
resolution: Validate the order object before processing order information.

title: Payment Gateway Timeout
root_cause: The external payment gateway did not respond within the configured timeout period.
resolution: Increase timeout handling and implement retry logic for temporary gateway failures.
